**`useChrome()` in launcher mode:** No nullable context needed — `useChrome()` already degrades safely via `ChromeContext`'s default value (`DETACHED_CHROME`, `activeVault: ''`), set up by T7. I derive `inLauncher = chrome.activeVault === ''` — safe because a real `WindowChrome` always seeds a non-empty `activeVault` from the launcher's `?vault=`, so `''` only ever means "no provider above me."

**Four `addTab` outcomes:** `'added'`/`'focused-tab'` → clear any notice, close palette. `'focused-window'` → same (handled generically even though T7 doesn't produce it yet; T20 will). `'refused-ceiling'` → palette stays **open**, a `role="status"` notice renders under the input naming the reason and pointing at the ⇧-click escape hatch (`openVaultWindow`). ⇧-click/⇧+Enter always calls `openVaultWindow` directly, bypassing the ceiling entirely, in both launcher and vault windows. ⌘1-9 now indexes `chrome.open` (vault window) or `openable` (launcher) — not the registry uniformly.
